instructions: Open the assigned tutorial segment and your own DaVinci Resolve project together. Watch a short demonstration, pause, repeat the action, and check the result before continuing. title: Cut Page Assembly and Workflow Comparison
instructions: Open the assigned tutorial segment and your own DaVinci Resolve project together. Watch a short demonstration, pause, repeat the action, and check the result before continuing. Keep the same saved project through all eleven lessons and use separate Cut/Fusion practice timelines where directed. Watching alone does not complete the assignment. For this lesson, watch 01:30:41-01:43:14. For Lessons 1-10, collect the required screenshots and short notes in one Google Doc or approved Drive folder, submit its share link in DCC, complete the evidence checklist, and type the reflection. requiredSteps: Reopen your ResolveFoundations project. Duplicate the existing mini-edit or create a separate four-clip timeline named Foundations_CutPractice so your polished edit stays available.

Select a source range, identify the highlighted edit point, and use Smart Insert once. Check where the clip landed; undo and repeat if the placement was unintended.

Trim and reorder the practice sequence into a clear 30-60 second, four-clip edit. Switch to Edit and verify that you are seeing the same timeline. Use mouse/keyboard controls; a Speed Editor is not required.

Save. Submit a Cut-page screenshot with both timeline views, a note about your Smart Insert and trim, and a two-sentence Cut/Edit workflow comparison in your evidence Doc. Submit the link and DCC reflection.
